title: What if you fell into a coma?
premise: First-person coma story: a night dive at summer camp, ICU weeks, a doctor ready to give up, and a brain scan that proves you're still there.

intro.title: What if you fell into a *coma*?

lines: Would you want them to keep trying?

beats.caption: Your friends dare you to dive. In the dark.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: The water is shallower than it looks.
beats.head: fall

beats.caption: Doctors score you a 3 out of 15. The lowest there is.

voices.text: No eye opening. No response to voice. GCS three.

beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: Your mom hasn't left the chair.

voices.text: Hey baby. It's Mom. I'm right here.

beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: You can hear her. You can't answer.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: Your phone keeps lighting up. Nobody reads it.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: "There may be no one in there anymore."

voices.text: I'm sorry. There may be no one in there anymore.

beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: "She's in there. I know she is."

voices.text: No. She's in there. I know she is.

beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: But about 4 in 10 times, that call is wrong.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: Week 7. They slide you into a brain scanner.
beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: A voice says: "Imagine walking through your home."

voices.text: If you can hear me... imagine walking through your home.

beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: So you do. Every room. Every door.
beats.head: walk

beats.caption: Your kitchen. Your bedroom. The squeaky stair.
beats.head: walk

beats.caption: On the screen, your brain lights up.

voices.text: Wait. Look at this. She's doing it.

beats.caption: About 1 in 4 people who can't move can do this.
You still can't move. But now they know you're there.

voices.text: We know you're in there. We're not going anywhere.

beats.head: breathe

beats.caption: And for the first time in weeks, someone talks to you. Not about you.
beats.head: breathe
